meta.episodes_from: scripts/eval_opponent.py episodes() on TRAIN_CLIPS (hard tier, no scripted hits)
meta.pre_grid_smoke: before the grid: one 12-bout train run (reps 1) of lead 0.25 with over 0 and over 1.0, a code smoke; it set the over-command values (see GRID)

pick.rule: largest train reduction in head clean/min (paired diff / policy rate) among configs with train survival >= 0.90

meta.why: v2 (arm_block_v2) was designed after v1's preregistered gate failed (results/sparring/oracle_val.json 'v1': -6%, NO-GO) and its review (forearm a median 0.11 m from its block point, arm joints 0.27 rad off target); tuned here on train clips only, then run once on val
meta.stats: vs_policy: config minus unmodified policy on identical episodes, exposure-weighted, (clip, start) cluster bootstrap (eval_opponent.vs_unaimed)
